correctness.rationale: The genus-six basis is derived from ramification valuations; coefficient extraction gives an explicit six-by-six matrix, and the actual Cartier matrix has entrywise seventh roots. Its two invariant semilinear blocks have stable ranks indicated by H and by U,V, giving all five rank strata. Matrix rank gives the a-number. The discriminant is exact; H has a unique ordinary node and no infinity singularity; \(H(a,a^3)=a^4(2+3a^5)\) and discriminant 4 at nonzero roots prove five rank-one smooth points. Two separately implemented standalone exact-arithmetic programs verify symbolic and prime-field consequences. Finite checks are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The two-parameter cyclic-quartic genus-six deformation of the \(y^4=x^5+1\) high-automorphism fiber exhibits all five possible characteristic-seven ranks 0 to 4. The deeper p-rank structure is governed by an integral nodal genus-two parameter curve and two rational components, with five isolated rank-one points and one rank-zero point. This is a complete geometrically motivated stratification, not an arbitrary isolated numerical invariant.
